stem: Two clone batches from the same donor date differ sharply in rooting success. The weaker batch also had a sanitation deviation and two hours of higher temperature. What is the strongest technician handoff?
choices: Present both process differences and the performance outcome as evidence requiring investigation without claiming either is the sole cause
State that the sanitation deviation definitely caused the loss
Discard the temperature record because sanitation seems more important
Change the rooting protocol without authorization
rationale: Multiple plausible factors should be preserved in the evidence package rather than reduced to an unsupported single cause.
